usedFor: Shopify holds the orders, and Facebook Messenger carries a page message through “Send Message from Page” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Message from Page” in Facebook Messenger
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is when a customer expects a quick word, and the message goes to them from your page.

watchOut: “Send Message from Page” reaches a customer outside your team, so it waits for your approval first.
